sql_in_cte:
WITH emp_office AS (
    SELECT office_location 
    FROM employee_directory 
    WHERE full_name = 'Haynes, Summer'
),
emp_rooms AS (
    SELECT fac_room_key 
    FROM fac_rooms 
    WHERE fac_room_key = (SELECT office_location FROM emp_office)
),
emp_building_address AS (
    SELECT BUILDING_KEY 
    FROM fac_building_address 
    WHERE BUILDING_KEY = (SELECT building_key FROM emp_rooms)
)

SELECT DISTINCT fac_rooms.Room, fac_rooms.floor, emp_building_address.BUILDING_KEY, BUILDINGS.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, emp_building_address.CITY, emp_building_address.STATE, emp_building_address.POSTAL_CODE 
FROM emp_rooms 
JOIN fac_rooms ON emp_rooms.fac_room_key = fac_rooms.fac_room_key 
JOIN emp_building_address ON fac_rooms.building_key = emp_building_address.BUILDING_KEY 
JOIN BUILDINGS ON BUILDINGS.BUILDING_KEY = emp_building_address.BUILDING_KEY 
WHERE emp_building_address.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET';

gold-question: List the long names of buildings constructed before 1950 that have more than 100 employees, the built year of the building, and number of employees.
gold-sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.year_built, COUNT(employee_directory.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.year_built) AS num_employees FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM STR_TO_DATE(date_built, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS year_built FROM fclt_building_hist) AS sub1 WHERE year_built < 1950) AS a JOIN fclt_rooms ON fclt_rooms.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT MIT_ID, OFFICE_LOCATION FROM employee_directory) AS employee_directory ON employee_directory.OFFICE_LOCATION = fclt_rooms.BUILDING_ROOM) AS sub2 WHERE num_employees > 100;

This query combines data from building history, room details, and employee directories to identify significant buildings and their workforce.
sql_in_cte:
WITH building_data AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM STR_TO_DATE(date_built, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS year_built 
    FROM fclt_building_hist
),
filtered_buildings AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM building_data
    WHERE year_built < 1950
),
employee_data AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT MIT_ID, OFFICE_LOCATION 
    FROM employee_directory
)
SELECT * 
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.year_built, COUNT(employee_data.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.year_built) AS num_employees 
    FROM filtered_buildings AS a 
    JOIN fclt_rooms ON fclt_rooms.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY 
    JOIN employee_data ON employee_data.OFFICE_LOCATION = fclt_rooms.BUILDING_ROOM
) AS sub2 
WHERE num_employees > 100;

    FROM fclt_rooms 
    JOIN mit_student_directory ON office_location = BUILDING_ROOM 
    GROUP BY fclt_building_key
),
max_students AS (
    SELECT MAX(num_students) AS max_num_students 
    FROM building_students
)
SELECT DISTINCT building_name, num_students 
FROM building_students AS a 
JOIN fclt_building ON a.fclt_building_key = fclt_building.fclt_building_key 
JOIN max_students AS b ON a.num_students = b.max_num_students;

sql_in_cte:
Here is the rewritten SQL query using Common Table Expressions (CTEs):

```sql
WITH subquery1 AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN FLOOR REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(FLOOR AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS f
    FROM FAC_FLOOR
),
subquery2 AS (
    SELECT MAX(f) AS highest_floor

)
SELECT DISTINCT B.BUILDING_NAME, A.FLOOR
FROM FAC_FLOOR A
JOIN FAC_BUILDING B ON A.BUILDING_KEY = B.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN subquery2 ON (CASE WHEN A.FLOOR REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(A.FLOOR AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END) = subquery2.highest_floor;
```

```sql
WITH TotalSquareFootage AS (
    SELECT SPACE_DETAIL.*, SUM(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_COMPONENT) AS Total_Square_Footage
    FROM SPACE_DETAIL
),
FacilitySupervisors AS (
    SELECT su.DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Total_Number_Facility, COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS Total_Supervisors, SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS Total_Supervisees
    FROM SPACE_UNIT su
    JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES
    GROUP BY su.DLC_KEY
)
SELECT su.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS Total_Number_Of_Floors, tsf.Total_Square_Footage, fs.Total_Number_Facility, fs.Total_Supervisors, fs.Total_Supervisees, SUM(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) AS Cumulative_Building_Height
FROM TotalSquareFootage tsf
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = tsf.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON tsf.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON tsf.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
JOIN FacilitySupervisors fs ON su.DLC_KEY = fs.DLC_KEY
JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY
GROUP BY su.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, tsf.Total_Square_Footage;
```

```sql
WITH TermCodes AS (
    SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.*, 
           CASE WHEN TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA' THEN 'Y' END AS A, 
           CASE WHEN TERM_CODE LIKE '%JA' THEN 'Y' END AS B, 
           CASE WHEN TERM_CODE LIKE '%SP' THEN 'Y' END AS C, 
           CASE WHEN TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU' THEN 'Y' END AS D 
    FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL
),
TermData AS (
    SELECT at.*, 
           SUBJECT_ID, 
           CASE WHEN at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_CURRENT_TERM2 
    FROM TermCodes at 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR 
        AND (IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = at.A OR IS_OFFERED_IAP = at.B OR IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = at.C OR IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = at.D)
)
SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, IS_CURRENT_TERM2, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_SUBJECTS 
FROM TermData 
GROUP BY TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, IS_CURRENT_TERM2;
```

```sql
           CASE WHEN INSTR(AUTHOR, ';') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(AUTHOR, 1, INSTR(AUTHOR, ';') - 1) ELSE AUTHOR END AS AUTHOR
    FROM TIP_MATERIAL
),
AggregatedData AS (
    SELECT tm.AUTHOR, 
           sd.SCHOOL_NAME, 
           tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, 
           SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS Total_Record_Count, 
           COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subject
```

```sql
WITH BuildingData AS (
    SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, SUM(fr.AREA) AS Total_Square_Footage, AVG(fr.AREA) AS Avg_Square_Footage_Per_Room
    FROM BUILDINGS b
    JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
    JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
    JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION fo ON fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY
    GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
),
BuildingAddressData AS (
    SELECT fba.BUILDING_KEY, fba.CITY, fba.STATE
    FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
    WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
)
SELECT DISTINCT new.BUILDING_NAME, new.BUILDING_NUMBER, fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT, new.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, fba.CITY, fba.STATE, new.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, new.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, new.Total_Square_Footage, new.Avg_Square_Footage_Per_Room
FROM BuildingData new
JOIN BuildingAddressData fba ON new.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb ON new.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY new.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC, new.Total_Square_Footage DESC, new.Avg_Square_Footage_Per_Room DESC;
```

```sql
WITH Total_Subjects AS (
    SELECT ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso
    JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
    WHERE at.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA'
    GROUP BY ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
)

SELECT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.FULL_NAME AS INSTRUCTOR, e.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ts.Total_Subjects
FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
JOIN Total_Subjects ts ON e.MIT_ID = ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
WHERE at.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA'
GROUP BY ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.FULL_NAME, e.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ts.Total_Subjects;
```

This query uses a CTE named `Total_Subjects` to calculate the total number of subjects offered by each responsible faculty member for the academic terms ending in 'FA'. The main query then joins this CTE to retrieve the subject title, instructor name, email address, and total subjects for each faculty member for the specified academic terms.

```sql
WITH TotalOrganizations AS (
    SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, sf.FLOOR, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, su2.SPACE_USAGE, COUNT(DISTINCT fo2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Total_Organizations
    FROM SPACE_UNIT su
    JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
    JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
    JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd2 ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
    JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo2 ON fo2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
    JOIN SPACE_USAGE su2 ON su2.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sd2.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
    JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY
    JOIN BUILDINGS b ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
    JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
    WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER = 36
    GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, sf.FLOOR, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, su2.SPACE_USAGE
),
TotalSpaceUnits AS (

    FROM SPACE_UNIT su
    JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
    JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd3 ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd3.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
    JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY
    JOIN BUILDINGS b ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
    JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
    WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER = 36
    GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, sf.FLOOR, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS
)
SELECT DISTINCT TOU.SPACE_UNIT, TOU.FLOOR, TOU.BUILDING_NAME, TOU.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, TOU.SPACE_USAGE, TOU.Total_Organizations, TSU.Total_Space_Units
```

```sql
WITH FilteredMoiraLists AS (
    SELECT MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_NAME 
    FROM MOIRA_LIST 
    WHERE MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'a%'
), 
FilteredMoiraListDetails AS (
    SELECT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY 
    FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld 
    JOIN FilteredMoiraLists fml ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = fml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
), 
FloorsWithLevels AS (
    SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, 
           MAX(ff.LEVEL_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ff.BUILDING_KEY) AS MAX_LEVEL, 
           MIN(ff.LEVEL_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ff.BUILDING_KEY) AS MIN_LEVEL 
    FROM FAC_BUILDING fb 
    JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY 
    JOIN FAC_FLOOR ff ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY
), 
FloorsPerBuilding AS (
    SELECT BUILDING_NAME, MAX_LEVEL - MIN_LEVEL + 1 AS NUM_FLOORS 
    FROM FloorsWithLevels 
    GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME, MAX_LEVEL, MIN_LEVEL
), 
MaxFloors AS (
    SELECT MAX(NUM_FLOORS) AS MAX_FLOORS 
    FROM FloorsPerBuilding
), 
BuildingWithMostFloors AS (
    SELECT a.BUILDING_NAME 
    FROM FloorsPerBuilding a 
    JOIN MaxFloors b ON a.NUM_FLOORS = b.MAX_FLOORS
), 
EmployeesInTallestBuildings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(e.KRB_NAME) AS KRB_NAME, fb.building_name 
    FROM BuildingWithMostFloors b 
    JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb ON b.BUILDING_NAME = fb.BUILDING_NAME 
    JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY 
    JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e ON e.OFFICE_LOCATION = fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY 
    WHERE UPPER(e.KRB_NAME) LIKE 'C%'
)

JOIN FilteredMoiraListDetails fmld ON UPPER(etb.KRB_NAME) = UPPER(fmld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) 
JOIN FilteredMoiraLists fml ON fmld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = fml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY;
```

WITH temp1 AS (
    SELECT IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y'), 'UNKNOWN') AS year_construct_began, BUILDING_NUMBER
    FROM FAC_BUILDING
    WHERE ownership_type = 'OWNED' AND PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL
),
temp2 AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL THEN year_construct_began ELSE CONCAT(year_construct_began, '*') END AS year_construct_began,
        BUILDING_NUMBER
    FROM temp1
    GROUP BY year_construct_began, BUILDING_NUMBER
    HAVING year_construct_began IS NOT NULL
),
temp3 AS (
    SELECT
        temp2.year_construct_began,
        temp2.BUILDING_NUMBER,
        CASE
            WHEN FAC_BUILDING.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL THEN IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(FAC_BUILDING.DATE_OCCUPIED, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y'), 'UNKNOWN')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS year_occupied,
        CASE
            WHEN FAC_BUILDING.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL THEN building_sort
            ELSE NULL
        END AS building_sort
    FROM temp2
    LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING ON FAC_BUILDING.BUILDING_NUMBER = temp2.BUILDING_NUMBER
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(year_construct_began) OVER (ORDER BY year_construct_began, building_sort, BUILDING_NUMBER) = year_construct_began THEN NULL
        WHEN BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE year_construct_began
    END AS `YEAR CONSTRUCT BEGAN`,
    BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING,
    year_occupied AS `YEAR INITIALLY OCCUPIED`
FROM temp3

```sql
WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT

            WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) = 1 THEN 'zzz'

            WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL'

        CASE 
            WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) = 1 THEN 'zzz' 
            ELSE MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER 
        END AS master,
        FORMAT(COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID), 0) AS subcnt,

    JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
```

        CASE 
            WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' 
            WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' 
            ELSE TERM_CODE

)

WITH cte_assignments AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
            WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NULL AND IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL THEN 'TOTAL'
            ELSE
                CASE
                    WHEN IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT'
                    ELSE 'NOT CURRENT'
                END
        END AS assign,
        IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS muse,
        COUNT(SESSION_DATE) AS session_count,
        SUM(COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(LEFT(SESSION_START_TIME, 2), ':', SUBSTRING(SESSION_START_TIME, 3, 2), ' ', RIGHT(SESSION_START_TIME, 2)), '%h:%i %p'), STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(LEFT(SESSION_END_TIME, 2), ':', SUBSTRING(SESSION_END_TIME, 3, 2), ' ', RIGHT(SESSION_END_TIME, 2)), '%h:%i %p')) / 24.0, 0)) AS total_time,
        AVG(COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(LEFT(SESSION_START_TIME, 2), ':', SUBSTRING(SESSION_START_TIME, 3, 2), ' ', RIGHT(SESSION_START_TIME, 2)), '%h:%i %p'), STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(LEFT(SESSION_END_TIME, 2), ':', SUBSTRING(SESSION_END_TIME, 3, 2), ' ', RIGHT(SESSION_END_TIME, 2)), '%h:%i %p')) / 24.0, 0)) AS avg_time
    FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL ss
    JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
    JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss ON iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
    JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY isc ON isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
    GROUP BY IS_CURRENT_TERM, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WITH ROLLUP
    HAVING IS_CURRENT_TERM IS NOT NULL OR IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    CASE WHEN LAG(assign) OVER (ORDER BY assign) = assign THEN NULL ELSE assign END AS assign,
    muse,
    session_count,
    total_time,
    avg_time
FROM cte_assignments
ORDER BY assign, muse;

    JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, ml.IS_PUBLIC
),
ListMostProminentDepartment AS (
    SELECT lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, lmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lmc.Student_Count, 
           @rank := IF(@current_list = lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, @rank + 1, 1) AS `Rank`, 
           @current_list := lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
    FROM (
        SELECT ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS Student_Count
        FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
        JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
        JOIN SE_PERSON se ON UPPER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) = UPPER(se.KRB_NAME)
        JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.FULL_NAME = se.FULL_NAME
        JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
        GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    ) lmc
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_list := '') vars
    ORDER BY lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, Student_Count DESC
)
SELECT lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, lmc.Member_Count, lmc.IS_PUBLIC, 
       dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, dc.Student_Count
FROM ListMemberCounts lmc
LEFT JOIN ListMostProminentDepartment dc 
ON lmc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = dc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AND dc.`Rank` = 1
ORDER BY lmc.Member_Count DESC
LIMIT 100;

sql_in_cte:
WITH FloorsPerBuilding AS (
    SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(ff.LEVEL_ID) - MIN(ff.LEVEL_ID) AS NUM_FLOORS
    FROM FAC_BUILDING fb
    JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
    JOIN FAC_FLOOR ff ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY
    GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME
), 
MaxFloors AS (
    SELECT MAX(NUM_FLOORS) AS MAX_FLOORS
    FROM FloorsPerBuilding
)
SELECT a.BUILDING_NAME
FROM FloorsPerBuilding a
JOIN MaxFloors b ON a.NUM_FLOORS = b.MAX_FLOORS;
